Title: TICKET-ADV001 - Create GitHub repo with branch protection
Acceptance Criteria: Repo is private and team can push feature branches; direct push to main is rejected and PR is required; main requires 2 approvals plus stale dismissal plus status checks build/test/lint; CODEOWNERS routes backend frontend db.

Title: TICKET-ADV002 - Design C4 Context diagram
Acceptance Criteria: Diagram has exactly one ReconX system box with external actors/systems only; every relationship arrow includes protocol and intent; artifact committed under db/diagrams or docs/architecture.

Title: TICKET-ADV003 - Design C4 Container diagram
Acceptance Criteria: ReconX boundary contains SPA API recon engine DB Kafka and observability as separate containers; arrows are protocol plus intent; external actors/systems remain outside boundary.

Title: TICKET-ADV004 - Design C4 Component diagram
Acceptance Criteria: Diagram title identifies target container; roughly 10-15 component boxes grouped by stereotype; external neighbors shown as referenced containers, not internal components.

Title: TICKET-ADV005 - Placeholder pending guide clarification
Acceptance Criteria: No TICKET-ADV005 section found in student guide or codebase TODOs; keep placeholder card and replace once trainer provides official acceptance criteria.

Title: TICKET-ADV006 - Design ER model (8 entities)
Acceptance Criteria: Exactly eight entities are modeled; every FK arrow points to parent and trades partition key is called out; diagram committed at db/erd.md or equivalent and reproducible by team.

Title: TICKET-ADV007 - CREATE TABLE with monthly partitioning
Acceptance Criteria: d+ trades shows partition key RANGE trade_date and monthly children; explain analyze on date filter scans only target month partition; at least April through July 2026 partitions plus trades_default exist.

Title: TICKET-ADV008 - Materialized view mv_daily_recon_summary
Acceptance Criteria: d+ view shows total_trades matched_trades open_breaks gross_notional match_rate_pct; unique index on trade_date region asset_class enables concurrent refresh; created via Liquibase sql changeset.

Title: TICKET-ADV009 - Add JSONB column to instruments
Acceptance Criteria: instruments has metadata jsonb not null default empty object; GIN index exists on metadata; explain analyze for metadata containment query uses GIN index, not seq scan.

Title: TICKET-ADV010 - Window function VWAP per instrument per day
Acceptance Criteria: Query returns one row per trade including qty price notional and vwap; vwap formula is sum price times qty over sum qty partitioned by instrument_id and trade_date; query stored in db/queries.sql and runs on seed data.

Title: TICKET-ADV011 - Recursive CTE trade lifecycle rollup
Acceptance Criteria: Recursive CTE has base case plus recursive union all step; termination guard prevents infinite recursion; result includes trade_id stage stage_name event_at event_status.

Title: TICKET-ADV012 - Liquibase master changelog
Acceptance Criteria: Master changelog exists with valid schema and no parse errors; each business object is in numbered chapter file under changes; application.yml points to classpath master changelog and app starts cleanly.

Title: TICKET-ADV013 - Add rollback tags
Acceptance Criteria: Each sql changeset has matching rollback block; at least one tagDatabase release tag exists after initial schema; rollbackSQL for release tag runs and emits sensible reverse DDL.

Title: TICKET-ADV014 - Add preconditions
Acceptance Criteria: Idempotent schema changesets have preconditions to avoid rerun; environment-gated seed uses contexts and row-existence check; preconditions use appropriate onFail mode with comments where non-obvious.

Title: TICKET-ADV015 - Use Claude to generate ADRs
Acceptance Criteria: At least three ADRs exist in docs/adr 0001 to 0003; each ADR has Nygard sections and ReconX-specific scale alternatives constraints; prompt template committed at docs/adr/README.md.

Title: TICKET-ADV016 - Set up Jira Kanban with epics
Acceptance Criteria: At least three epics group Day 1 exercises; one card per exercise ID with owner estimate and acceptance criteria; board has Backlog To Do In Progress In Review Done and at least one card flowed end-to-end.

Title: TICKET-ADV017 - Seed data 10 counterparties 50 instruments 500 trades
Acceptance Criteria: SQL counts return 10 counterparties 50 instruments 500 trades; trades spread roughly evenly across April to July 2026 partitions; seed runs in FK-safe order and is gated from prod via precondition or dev/test context.
